title: Box
description: A polymorphic container with spacing, size, background, radius and shadow shorthands.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Numeric spacing selects tokens (4 -> var(--space-4)); bg accepts surface aliases.

sizing.title: Sizing and centering
sizing.description: Size props take pixels or CSS lengths; mx="auto" centers a bounded box.

polymorphic.title: Polymorphic element
polymorphic.description: Use as to render semantic elements such as ul / li or section.

BoxProps.p: All-sides padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.px: Horizontal padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.py: Vertical padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.pt: Top padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.pr: Right padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.pb: Bottom padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.pl: Left padding (spacing token or CSS value)
BoxProps.m: All-sides margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.mx: Horizontal margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.my: Vertical margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.mt: Top margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.mr: Right margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.mb: Bottom margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.ml: Left margin (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")
BoxProps.w: Width: numbers are pixels, strings are CSS lengths
BoxProps.h: Height: numbers are pixels, strings are CSS lengths
BoxProps.bg: Background: a surface alias (bg, bg.subtle, bg.muted, bg.canvas, bg.elevated, bg.emphasis) or any CSS background
BoxProps.rounded: Border radius: a radius token (none, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, full) or any CSS value
BoxProps.boxShadow: Box shadow: a shadow token (sm, md, lg, xl) or any CSS value

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The element itself is the box: p, bg, rounded, box-shadow and border are applied to the host.

spacing-sizing.title: Spacing and sizing
spacing-sizing.description: Numbers select spacing tokens (p="4" is var(--space-4)), other strings are CSS values; sizes (w, h, min-/max-) are pixels or CSS lengths. Side attributes win over axis ones, which win over the all-sides shorthand.

surfaces.title: Surfaces, radius and shadow
surfaces.description: bg accepts the surface aliases (bg, bg.subtle, bg.muted, bg.canvas, bg.elevated) or any CSS background; rounded and box-shadow accept tokens or CSS values.
